Follow-up correction to the same-day exact-sum review: docs 40746 and 44555 were initially flagged as misattribution candidates on aggregate-total exact-sum coincidences alone. A check against allocation_edges.csv's invoice-level rows (missed on the first pass) retracted both. That retraction was itself premature and has been reversed: the invoice-level rows for both payments are unconfirmed (ERP_LEDGER/Probable, not HUMAN_WORKSHEET_AND_ERP/Confirmed) and structurally look like a mechanical FIFO fill of an already-assumed month, not independent evidence -- business_rules.md SS3 already warns the ERP's own payment allocation is historically broken. Verdict: both payments' true month (40746: Jun vs Jul 2025; 44555: Mar-2026 vs Dec-2025) are genuinely unresolved pending a real remittance advice -- neither the CSV nor the yearly reports should be cited as settled on this point. Report and registry table (evidence_status: ASSERTED -- UNRESOLVED) updated in place.

Two further checks on the same open item (docs 40746/44555, see prior entry). (1) Shell/CYL contamination ruled out: per docs/governance/sku_suffix_mapping.md (.1-suffix SKUs are the brand-neutral cylinder deposit 'shell asset' and must be stripped from the LPG ledger), recomputed is_lpg=True-only totals directly from invoices.csv for all 4 candidate months (2025-06, 2025-07, 2025-12, 2026-03) -- all match monthly_lpg_insights.csv exactly to the cent, and every invoice line under both payments' target docs is a pure gas-content line with no mixed-in deposit line. (2) Corrected an overstatement in the prior entry: payment 39812's UNALLOCATED_PORTION tag is routine (32 of 78 payments carry it across all 9 years, several already ratified), not a unique anomaly. What is genuinely unusual is that 39812 and doc 38846 (R27,895.66 combined, 2025-05/06) have no month assignment at all in monthly_lpg_insights.csv, unlike those ratified cases -- flagged as the most promising unexplored thread for resolving the dispute, alongside April/May 2025 both showing fully UNPAID. Report SS5 updated with both findings; verdict remains UNRESOLVED.

Resolved the 38846/39812 thread flagged in the prior entry. An exhaustive contiguous-run search of invoices.csv's LPG invoice sequence (not just aggregate month totals) found a cent-exact partial-month split: doc 38846 (R7,337.97) = first 2 January-2025 invoices (39558+39714); doc 39812 (R20,557.69) = remaining 3 January invoices + all 3 February invoices. Combined they settle all of January + February 2025 (R27,895.66 = R17,574.84 + R10,320.82) exactly -- not orphaned cash. CYL-adjusted combinations were checked and not needed (cylinder_transactions.csv shows the deposit/return pairs net to ~R0 every cycle in this window). Applied the fix directly to monthly_lpg_insights.csv (Jan/Feb 2025 moved UNPAID -> FULLY_SETTLED, both docs recorded as refs). This does not resolve the separate doc 40746/44555 June-vs-July / Mar-2026-vs-Dec-2025 dispute, which remains UNRESOLVED -- it is a different pair of payments in an adjacent window. NOTE: this entry originally (incorrectly) claimed the pre-2021 orphaned-cash total dropped from R54,902.41 to R27,006.44 -- that was an arithmetic error, corrected in the next entry. The 38846/39812 pair was never part of that R54,902.41 figure; the two groups were always separate.

Tried the same contiguous-run search on the remaining 14 pre-2021 orphaned payments (R54,902.41, unchanged from original -- see correction note in prior entry). Does NOT resolve, for principled reasons: (1) ambiguous/duplicate matches -- e.g. docs 7226 (2020-06-29) and 7489 (2020-09-04), months apart, both 'match' the identical invoice range, which is impossible for two real payments; (2) this era's invoice amounts are round multiples of a standard per-unit rate (R700.01, R1,400.01, R3,000, R5,000, etc.) that recur constantly, unlike Jan/Feb 2025's unique non-round sums; (3) a genuine ~10-month invoicing gap (Apr 2020-Feb 2021, no LPG invoices recorded at all) that a naive index-based search would otherwise silently bridge. Verdict: these 14 payments cannot be resolved by this method, consistent with SS0's applicability boundary (pre-STAT-batch era, round ad hoc on-account payments, not sums targeting specific invoices). Resolving them needs a period bank statement or bordereau, not further search over this dataset. Report SS6/SS9 updated; recommendation changed from 'keep searching' to 'do not re-search, different evidence needed.'
